target_customer: Young retail investors who discuss investing with friends in group chats
problem: Gen Z investors traded tips in GroupMe and Discord, separate from their brokerage portfolios; Finary combined portfolios and chat in one app.
business_model: Consumer social investing app, monetization not found

founders.name: Roger Cawdette
education: Harvard, Technological and Social Innovation, left after sophomore year
founders.background_notes: Sources: YC page and NYC Founder Guide interview (2022-11-28).

competitors.name: Commonstock
competitors.what: Social investment platform to share ideas, trades and portfolio performance

competitors.name: Public.com
competitors.what: Investing app with a social network, public portfolios and comments

technical_complexity.rationale: Chat plus brokerage account linking and portfolio sync is standard consumer fintech engineering with integration challenges.

defensibility.rationale: Friend group chat could create network effects, but Public.com and Commonstock already offered social features and a chat layer is easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying it; the company reportedly shut down by March 2023.

market_need_then: In 2020 and 2021 retail investing surged and young investors traded tips in chat groups; NYC Founder Guide describes the founder seeing classmates do this.

branding.domain_note: Dataset lists about.finary.io; the .com is used by an unrelated Paris wealth app also named Finary.
branding.community_and_virality: Pitched as a community for young investors; covered by Fortune and Ypulse in April 2021.

brand_strength.rationale: Some press at launch, but a same name Paris company (also YC) causes confusion and no sustained brand evidence was found.

outcome_analysis: Finary raised a reported 3.2M seed in April 2021 and was still described as active in a November 2022 interview. A review site updated March 2023 says it would shut down; no company statement or post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public. The failure factor is a weak inference from no later round being found and is not stated by a source.
notes: about.finary.io did not resolve. Seed rests on Benzinga plus aggregator data (CB Insights total 3.33M, an aggregator also lists a 125K YC pre-seed); a second outlet (Upfront blog, Fortune) exists but was not readable. Shutdown rests on a single secondary review site. A Paris company called Finary (finary.com) is unrelated; its figures were excluded. Competitor sources are 2021 articles with day not stated.
